title: GPU Count Mismatch
description: Flags servers where the number of GPUs actually visible via the BMC doesn't match the configured GPU count from inventory. Uses redfish_gpu_temperature_celsius (not redfish_gpu_health) as the 'visible GPU' signal, with an explicit exception for SuperMicro: that firmware only ever exposes 3 zone-level temperature sensors per server regardless of GPU count (a documented, expected limitation, not a gap), so SuperMicro hosts are compared against 3, not against gpu_count. redfish_gpu_health was tried first and rejected - Lenovo's firmware never exposes a GPU Processor resource at all, so redfish_gpu_health is completely absent there even though temperature (via a PCIe-slot-sensor fallback) is a genuine 1:1 match with gpu_count; using health would have falsely flagged every Lenovo host as 100% missing. Known limitation: a server that has NEVER once successfully scraped has no redfish_gpu_count_configured series at all (the exporter only emits it after actually reaching the BMC), so it won't appear in this table - those are already covered by the RedfishTargetDown alert and the up{job="redfish"} panels elsewhere.

panels.title: Servers With Mismatch
panels.description: Count of servers where visible GPUs (redfish_gpu_temperature_celsius, or 3 for SuperMicro) != configured GPUs (inventory gpu_count).

panels.title: Total GPUs Missing
panels.description: Sum of (expected - visible) across servers with a mismatch. Expected = gpu_count for all vendors except SuperMicro, which is compared against 3 (its documented zone-sensor ceiling) instead.

targets.expr:
sum(
  clamp_min(
    (redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor!="SuperMicro"} - on(instance) group_left() (count by (instance) (redfish_gpu_temperature_celsius{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor!="SuperMicro"}) or on(instance) (0 * redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor!="SuperMicro"})))
  , 0)
)
+
sum(
  clamp_min(
    ((0*redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor="SuperMicro"}+3) - on(instance) group_left() (count by (instance) (redfish_gpu_temperature_celsius{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor="SuperMicro"}) or on(instance) (0 * redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor="SuperMicro"})))
  , 0)
)
or vector(0)

panels.title: Total Configured GPUs
panels.description: sum(redfish_gpu_count_configured) for the current site/vendor filter - the expected fleet total to compare against.

panels.title: Servers With GPU Count Mismatch
panels.description: Value column = expected GPUs minus visible GPUs (expected is gpu_count, except for SuperMicro which is compared against 3 - its documented zone-sensor ceiling, not a per-GPU count). Positive = fewer GPUs visible than expected (missing coverage - auth/crawl/firmware issue). Negative = more visible than expected (inventory.csv gpu_count is likely wrong for that host). Click a row to open Server Detail.

targets.expr:
(
  (redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor!="SuperMicro"} - on(instance) group_left() (count by (instance) (redfish_gpu_temperature_celsius{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor!="SuperMicro"}) or on(instance) (0 * redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor!="SuperMicro"}))) != 0
)
or
(
  ((0*redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor="SuperMicro"}+3) - on(instance) group_left() (count by (instance) (redfish_gpu_temperature_celsius{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor="SuperMicro"}) or on(instance) (0 * redfish_gpu_count_configured{site=~"$site", vendor=~"$vendor", vendor="SuperMicro"}))) > 0
)
